what_works: Ancestral-storytelling site uses muted moss-green and cream with a tall serif logotype — the page reads like a family history book opened to chapter one. Generation-by-generation timeline composition is the exact pattern a multi-gen contractor needs ('Grandpa started in 1962. Dad ran it from 1989. I took over in 2018.').
what_does_not_translate: Ireland-specific cultural imagery (Celtic, landscape) won't apply — keep the timeline + cream/moss palette + serif logotype, swap in the contractor's actual archival photos.
type_observations: Tall serif display (Cormorant / Playfair feel) for headlines, italic accent serif for pull-quotes, neutral sans body — three serif registers do the heritage work.
